grammar.summary: 本课以古玩店淘宝为线索，集中运用了定语从句、非谓语动词（分词与不定式）与 the more... the more 句型，并出现 was about to do when... 表示「正要……这时」。重点体会描写中如何用定语从句补充物品背景、用分词短语表现发现过程。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 where/that/which 引导定语从句。where 指地点关系，that/which 指物。本课用 where 修饰古玩店，用 that 修饰杂货堆，使描写细致。

examples.en: The more expensive kind of antique shop where rare objects are beautifully displayed in glass cases to keep them free from dust is usually a forbidding place.
examples.cn: 高档一点的古玩店为了防尘，把文物漂亮地陈列在玻璃柜子里，那里往往令人望而却步。

examples.en: There is always hope that in its labyrinth of musty, dark, disordered rooms a real rarity will be found amongst the piles of assorted junk that little the floors.
examples.cn: 人们还常常有希望在发霉、阴暗、杂乱无章、迷宫般的店堂里，从杂乱地摆放在地面上的、一堆堆各式各样的破烂货里找到一件稀世珍品。

points.title: 非谓语动词：分词与不定式 (Participles & Infinitives)
points.explanation: 现在分词 (v-ing) 作状语表主动伴随，过去分词 (v-ed) 表被动完成，不定式 (to do) 表目的或将来。本课用 bent on making 表示「专心于」，用 lying 表示「放着」，层层刻画发现过程。

examples.en: Like a scientist bent on making a discovery, he must cherish the hope that one day he will be amply rewarded.
examples.cn: 他必须像一个专心致志进行探索的科学家那样抱有这样的希望，即终有一天，他的努力会取得丰硕的成果。

examples.en: The morning passed rapidly and Frank was about to leave when he noticed a large packing case lying on the floor.
examples.cn: 上午很快过去了，弗兰克正准备离去，突然看见地板上放着一只体积很大的货箱。

examples.en: Frank gently lifted the crockery out of the box an suddenly noticed a miniature painting at the bottom of the packing case.
examples.cn: 弗兰克轻轻地把陶器拿出箱子，突然发现在箱底有一幅微型画。

points.title: was about to do when... 句型 (Be about to + when)
points.explanation: be about to do sth when... 表示「正要做某事，这时（突然）……」，when 在此为并列连词，引出突发情况。本课描写弗兰克正要离开时突然发现货箱，制造转折。

examples.en: The morning passed rapidly and Frank was about to leave when he noticed a large packing case lying on the floor.
examples.cn: 上午很快过去了，弗兰克正准备离去，突然看见地板上放着一只体积很大的货箱。

exercises.q: The more expensive kind of antique shop ______ rare objects are beautifully displayed in glass cases to keep them free from dust is usually a forbidding place.
The morning passed rapidly and Frank was about to leave ______ he noticed a large packing case lying on the floor.
Like a scientist ______ on making a discovery, he must cherish the hope that one day he will be amply rewarded.
下列哪个词与课文中 rarity 的含义最接近？
用分词填空：The morning passed rapidly and Frank was about to leave when he noticed a large packing case ______ (lie) on the floor.（写出 lie 的正确形式）
